answer: Leather hides hang in the saddler's shop, tanned and supple. knoll cuts the seat leather to the pattern and skives the edge. Proof of saddler via stitched saddle tally — a saddle the saddler stitches only after 691 saddles stitch true without one seam giving at the pommel, each stitched by the saddler himself. signal stuffs the panels with flock and stitches them even. saffron fits the stirrup leathers and tests the tree for flex. Six hundred and ninety-one saddles must stitch true without one seam giving at the pommel, and the next still gives where the thread ran weak.
